options.description: Mapping of aircrack-ng command-line options (keys are flag names, values are values or booleans where applicable). Only documented options are included. Use bare scalar or list of scalars where appropriate; omit keys for options not used.

options.airolib_db.description: Path to airolib-ng database (cannot be used with -w)

options.combine_macs.description: List of AP MAC addresses to merge into a virtual AP

options.essid.description: Target network ESSID (SSID); required for cloaked SSIDs or WPA

options.ewsa_output_file.description: Output file for Elcomsoft Wireless Security Auditor project

options.hashcat_hccapx_output_file.description: Output HCCAPX file for Hashcat v3.6+

options.key_output_file.description: Path to write the recovered key

options.nbcpu.description: Number of CPUs to use for cracking; 0 means auto-detect (use all)

options.restore_session_file.description: Session save file to restore with -R

options.simd.description: Force SIMD optimization: generic, sse2, avx, avx2, avx512, neon, asimd, altivec, power8

options.wep_disable_korek.description: List of KoreK attack indices (1–17) to disable

options.wep_enable_bruteforce_last_two_b.description: Enable last two keybytes bruteforcing (equivalent to -x2)

options.wep_mac_filter.description: MAC filter for IVs (e.g., 'ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff' or a specific MAC)

options.wep_max_ivs.description: Maximum number of IVs to use

options.wep_ptw_debug.description: PTW debug level (1 = disable klein, 2 = PTW debug)

options.wep_search_bcd.description: Search binary coded decimal characters only

options.wep_show_ascii_key.description: Show ASCII version of the key

options.wordlist.description: List of dictionary files; use 'h:' prefix and ':' separators for hex keys

options.wpa_speed_test_duration.description: Duration (seconds) of the WPA speed test
